description: Host-conforming floor slab. Attach to a SPACE (from Space Properties): the slab takes the space's polygon as its footprint — there are no plan-size parameters here. `thickness` extrudes the polygon downward from `level`, and `color` fills it in both the 2D plan and the 3D view. Because the footprint is the host space, this object has no `geometry` block; the renderer builds the slab from the host polygon + these params.
